title: Clean Architecture
description: Build applications with separated concerns and dependency inversion.

data.text: **Clean Architecture** separates the software into concentric layers, with dependencies pointing inward. The core domain has no dependencies on external frameworks or databases.

items: Domain – Entities, value objects, domain events

data.title: Clean Architecture Structure
data.content:
MyApp.Domain/
├── Entities/
│   └── Order.cs
├── ValueObjects/
│   └── Money.cs
└── Events/
    └── OrderPlaced.cs

MyApp.Application/
├── Interfaces/
│   └── IOrderRepository.cs
├── DTOs/
│   └── OrderDto.cs
└── UseCases/
    └── CreateOrder.cs

MyApp.Infrastructure/
├── Persistence/
│   └── OrderRepository.cs
└── Services/
    └── EmailService.cs

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Clean Architecture creates maintainable, testable, and flexible applications.
